quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 In summary 后的结尾总括结论

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在听力结尾处快速抓住总结信号，避免把前文分点误当主旨。

major_issues: Existing flip card asks for a summary but hides the checkable answer on the back.
The analysis is template-heavy and even echoes back-side answer wording instead of teaching how In summary marks the conclusion.
No quality_metadata is present, so source/audio and review status are not explicit.
minor_issues: Audio file quality is not formally reviewed; current review only covers text/task design.
cards.recommendation: Rewrite as an auto-scored multiple_choice card that tests the conclusion after In summary.

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 根据 Overall 和 most effective way 概括结尾主旨

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户把结尾总结句中的评价强度和对象关系转化为稳定的主旨选择。

major_issues: Existing multiple_choice direction is usable, but the analysis is template-heavy and does not teach Overall / most effective way as ending-summary signals.
The card lacks quality_metadata, leaving simulated source and TTS boundaries implicit.
Distractor rationale should distinguish reviewed factors from the final mentoring conclusion.
minor_issues: Keep the core answer direction but rewrite prompt, options, analysis, and metadata for sample review.
cards.recommendation: Retain the transcript and answer direction, but make the ending-summary rule explicit.

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 To sum up 后的长期总括结论

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在结尾处从短期铺垫切换到长期总括，避免把局部困难误判为主旨。

major_issues: Existing timing-click task is downcast to flip, so the front promises click behavior that is not exposed by the product contract here.
The answer-window back side cannot serve as a self-contained front-side learning task.
The card should test the conclusion after To sum up rather than unreviewed timing-window behavior.
minor_issues: Original time_window_ms is unsuitable for this candidate sample branch because audio timing has not been formally reviewed.
cards.recommendation: Rewrite as multiple_choice to filter short-term setup and select the final long-term conclusion.

batch_review.box_progression: The existing first three cards do not yet form a clean recognition -> application -> transfer progression for 结尾总结.
repetition_or_gap_risks: Two cards depend on back-side or timing-window answer revelation rather than front-side solvable choices.
Source and TTS status are not explicit in quality_metadata.
batch_review.next_step: Revise only the first three cards as a candidate sample and keep it out of approved_batches until explicit user confirmation.
